title: The Roles & Permissions list page loads with its columns and a create button
preconds: 1. You are logged in as an admin on Settings > Roles & Permissions.
steps:
1. Open Settings > Roles & Permissions.
  2. Look at the page heading, the table columns and the create button.
expected:
The page heading reads Roles & Permissions.

The table shows columns for the role name, description, template, role type, users and an actions column (with a lock icon on system-role rows).

There is a button to create a new role.

(Confirm the exact column order and button label live.)
